scope: npm run render:bench cells: steady camera after terrain settles, except the moving drive scene; p50/p95 in ms. render = main-thread render callback; gpuMs = timer query around the render callback's GL commands (absent on the phone); renderFinishMs = render + gl.finish() in a separate window. 'before' is commit 6fd0d4be (one mesh per chunk), 'after' the merged meshes of phase 3c. drawCallsPerFrame of the fixed view counts its batches only; meshDrawCallsPerFrame (after runs) adds the vehicle meshes it draws into images. The 3D views' count includes vehicle meshes. Rabbits wander and traffic varies, so populated scenes are not exact replays. One run per cell.
